integrity: The sign proof is analytic: it reduces the exact source formula to nested one-variable inequalities. The source formula, domain, publication date, and primary classification were independently checked; no numerical experiment is used as a proof of the global statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the normalized Haar measure and coordinate-cube target of the cited 2013 source, only along its controlled-gate Weyl edge. It does not compare arbitrary target shapes, physical noise models, control costs, or gates outside that edge.
title: Finite-precision Haar target volume is strictly ordered along the controlled-gate edge
